say:2:1029713001:1.text: Soren and I happened to be patrolling nearby. We heard the fighting and came running!
say:2:1029713001:1.source_cn: 我和索恩正好在附近巡逻，听到有打斗声，第一时间就赶过来了！

say:3:1029713002:1.text: Didn't expect to bump into you, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. And who's this?
say:3:1029713002:1.male: Didn't expect to bump into you, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. And who's this?
say:3:1029713002:1.female: Didn't expect to bump into you, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. And who's this?

say:4:1029713003:0.text: Rowan, at your service! I'm here on behalf of the Mithril Consortium to, uh... investigate the local trade situation.
say:4:1029713003:0.source_cn: 你好，我是罗万，代表秘银商会前来……呃，调查一下此处的...

say:5:1029713004:1.text: Aha, merchants! That explains the caravan. No wonder those guys targeted you.
say:5:1029713004:1.source_cn: 啊，你们是商人啊，怪不得有车队！也怪不得会被那些家伙盯上！

choice_prompt:6:1029713004.text: Aha, merchants! That explains the caravan. No wonder those guys targeted you.
choice_prompt:6:1029713004.source_cn: 啊，你们是商人啊，怪不得有车队！也怪不得会被那些家伙盯上！

say:7:1029713005:1.text: Yep. Bandits love to lurk around here. Traders and travelers get ambushed all the time!
say:7:1029713005:1.source_cn: 是的，你也知道，我们这边总是有不少盗匪出没，行商和旅者...
say:7:1029713005:1.male: Yep. Bandits love to lurk around here. Traders and travelers get ambushed all the time!
say:7:1029713005:1.female: Yep. Bandits love to lurk around here. Traders and travelers get ambushed all the time!

say:8:1029713007:1.text: Brutus already has patrols running and put out bounties. Hunters have been chasing them nonstop.
say:8:1029713007:1.source_cn: 其实布鲁特斯大人已经安排过各个氏族严防死守，还给了不少...

say:9:1029713008:1.text: But they've gotten smarter lately. They just camp out near the key entrances and exits.
say:9:1029713008:1.source_cn: 但这段时间他们学乖了，就守在重要的出入口，几处要道。

say:10:1029713009:1.text: Anyone taking these main roads either has too much cargo to take the side paths or they're first-timers.
say:10:1029713009:1.source_cn: 会走这种大路的要不然是货物多的不好走小路，要不就是初到...

say:11:1029713010:1.text: Rowan, this is your first time being here. Bringing only a small load and light carts was definitely the right call.
say:11:1029713010:1.source_cn: 这位罗万先生，你第一次来这里，却没带很多货品，车子也很...

say:12:1029713011:0.text: Ah, thank you. Sorry, I didn't catch your name?
say:12:1029713011:0.source_cn: 啊，谢谢，还不知道你怎么称呼——

say:13:1029713012:1.text: Right! Hello! I'm Alsa! And this quiet guy here is Soren.
say:13:1029713012:1.source_cn: 对了，你好！我叫阿尔萨，这个不爱说话的家伙是索恩！

choice_prompt:16:1029713012.text: Right! Hello! I'm Alsa! And this quiet guy here is Soren.
choice_prompt:16:1029713012.source_cn: 对了，你好！我叫阿尔萨，这个不爱说话的家伙是索恩！

say:17:1029713013:1.text: Can you blame me? The bandit attacks haven't let up, and now they're slipping through patrols like smoke.
say:17:1029713013:1.source_cn: 因为我也很生气嘛，我和索恩出来巡逻就是这段时间出事太多了。

say:18:1029713014:1.text: We didn't even know you were coming until the ambush started.
say:18:1029713014:1.source_cn: 结果那些盗匪还是神出鬼没的，我们都不知道你们过来了，就...

say:19:1029713015:1.text: If you weren't so strong, <style="stress"><player_name></style>, the Uru Clan's reputation would've taken a serious hit!
say:19:1029713015:1.male: If you weren't so strong, <style="stress"><player_name></style>, the Uru Clan's reputation would've taken a serious hit!
say:19:1029713015:1.female: If you weren't so strong, <style="stress"><player_name></style>, the Uru Clan's reputation would've taken a serious hit!

choice_prompt:20:1029713015.text: If you weren't so strong, <style="stress"><player_name></style>, the Uru Clan's reputation would've taken a serious hit!
choice_prompt:20:1029713015.source_cn: 幸好<style=stress><player_name></style>你们实力强劲，否则我们乌尔氏族的威名就要丢了！
choice_prompt:20:1029713015.male: If you weren't so strong, <style="stress"><player_name></style>, the Uru Clan's reputation would've taken a serious hit!
choice_prompt:20:1029713015.female: If you weren't so strong, <style="stress"><player_name></style>, the Uru Clan's reputation would've taken a serious hit!

say:21:1029713016:1.text: You mean people watching the routes and signaling the ambush teams?
say:21:1029713016:1.source_cn: 你是说，专门安排人监控通行处，然后及时通风报信？
say:21:1029713016:1.male: You mean people watching the routes and signaling the ambush teams?
say:21:1029713016:1.female: You mean people watching the routes and signaling the ambush teams?

say:23:1029713018:1.text: But we've been patrolling nonstop! If they had scouts, how haven't we seen them?
say:23:1029713018:1.source_cn: 但，我和索恩一直到处巡逻，没看到过类似的队伍啊……

say:24:1029713019:1.text: We've been focused on the raiders themselves. A small outpost could stay hidden easily.
say:24:1029713019:1.source_cn: 不，我们此前目标一直是劫匪的队伍，而岗哨不需要太多人，...

say:25:1029713020:1.text: ... I think I know where they'd hide them.
say:25:1029713020:1.source_cn: 唔，我大概知道，他们会在哪里布哨了。

choice_prompt:26:1029713020.text: ... I think I know where they'd hide them.
choice_prompt:26:1029713020.source_cn: 唔，我大概知道，他们会在哪里布哨了。

say:27:1029713021:1.text: Soren knows this terrain like the back of his hand. He just hadn't considered they'd use it for lookouts, which is why we never found them.
say:27:1029713021:1.source_cn: 索恩把周围的地形可是摸得一清二楚，只是之前没往岗哨的方...

say:28:1029713022:1.text: Hmph! But now that you've pointed it out, <style="stress"><player_name></style>, we'll definitely catch them this time!
say:28:1029713022:1.male: Hmph! But now that you've pointed it out, <style="stress"><player_name></style>, we'll definitely catch them this time!
say:28:1029713022:1.female: Hmph! But now that you've pointed it out, <style="stress"><player_name></style>, we'll definitely catch them this time!

choice:16:0:1.text: Still as energetic as ever, huh?
choice:16:0:1.male: Still as energetic as ever, huh?
choice:16:0:1.female: Still as energetic as ever, huh?

say:30:1029713006:1.text: Exactly. They wait by the big routes, lying in wait for merchants who are new to the area.
say:30:1029713006:1.source_cn: 对，那些盗匪就是喜欢对初到此处的行商下手！
